examples.cmd: patator ssh_login host=<ip_or_host> user=FILE0 password=FILE1 0=<path/to/users.txt> 1=<path/to/passwords.txt> --rate_limit=<seconds> --timeout=<seconds> -x ignore:mesg='Authentication failed.'
examples.explanation: Brute force ssh login with rate limit and timeout options (successful login will show login banner or something similar)

examples.cmd: patator http_fuzz url=<http://host:port> auth_type=basic user_pass=COMBO00:COMBO01 0=<path/to/userpass.txt> -x ignore:code=401
examples.explanation: Brute force http basic auth (payload file `userpass.txt` should be in the format `username:password`)
